dinners.heads_up: Start the crock pot by 8:30 am (about 30 min: brown the beef, then dump in the rest). 20 min before dinner, thicken and add peas.
About 25 min: rice cooker plus salmon in the oven. Move the salmon to the fridge Sunday night if frozen.
About 30 min with store-bought teriyaki sauce. Start the rice first.
About 35 min: 2 sheet pans in the oven, stir the feta topping while it bakes.
About 25 min. Move 2.5 lb ground beef to the fridge Wednesday night if frozen.
